description: Update a subtask title, status or position. depends_on sets what it waits on, blocks the inverse; both replace the set, [] clears. Starting or finishing one with unmet prerequisites needs force.

blocks.description: Siblings that wait on this one — inverse of depends_on

depends_on.description: Siblings this one waits on (replaces the set)

force.description: Proceed despite unmet prerequisites. Only when a human says the blocker no longer applies, never on your own initiative. Logged.

name: subtask_update
